What changed: the evidence base now includes operational incident evidence that was absent in the prior documentation-only thread, partially resolving the earlier open question of whether the documented guarantee holds in practice. What is current: the documentation still describes exactly-once delivery (delta-doc), and the incident report records duplicate deliveries during DQ-17 (delta-incident). What remains historically valid: the documented exactly-once claim (delta-doc) stands as the documented position, though it is now qualified by observed duplicate deliveries. What is unresolved: whether the documentation has been updated since DQ-17, whether the duplicates fell within the guarantee's intended scope or conditions, whether the root cause was fixed, and whether duplicates can still occur — none of these can be determined from the supplied snapshots.
